region.name: the Oakenreach
region.blurb: Golden fields in the west, windy sheep-hills and old oak woods in the middle, and in the east the haunted barrows of Murkmarsh.

towns.name: Queensgate
towns.blurb: A walled city of bell towers and busy markets. The Queen's summer castle stands over it all.

mayor.name: Count Dunstan
mayor.title: Count
mayor.avatar: small, brisk count with a bushy black beard, a mustard-yellow waistcoat, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: Queensgate welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Queensgate is the pride of the Oakenreach, and we are glad to have you.

quest.title: The Temple Wind-Chime
offer: The chapel wind-chime was stolen, and now the chapel is far too quiet.
The thief was seen running toward Ashwood. Bring it back and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Temple Wind-Chime? The thief was seen running toward Ashwood.
done: The wind-chime! Hear how it rings.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: Ned's General Store

keeper.name: Ned
keeper.avatar: soot-faced armourer with a thick moustache and a hammer on his belt

lines: Best prices in Queensgate! Well, the only prices in Queensgate.

workshop.name: Alaric's Workshop

keeper.name: Alaric
keeper.avatar: wiry tinker with goggles, a tool belt and a grin

lines: Anvil, cauldron, grindstone: use what you like. Pedal hard and it all goes faster!

npcs.name: Hollis
npcs.avatar: freckled child with a wooden sword and a helmet three sizes too big
lines: Have you ever fought a wild boar? What was it like?
Lord Toby of Windknoll is looking for a courier to Queensgate.

gives.line: Are you a real hero? Mum says heroes always carry healing draughts. Here, take one of mine!

npcs.name: Smith Barnaby
npcs.avatar: muscular smith with soot-streaked arms and a leather apron
lines: Hammer and anvil, all day long. Look at these arms!
I can build up yours too, for a fee.
Tamsin's Trading Post in Heathercombe sells an Emberheart Amulet. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.

npcs.name: Fisher Delphine
npcs.avatar: weathered fisher in oilskins, with a net over one shoulder
lines: The tide brings in all sorts. Pearls, if you look in the right places.
The Temple Wind-Chime from Queensgate is hidden in the Woodcutter's Shed in Ashwood.

spots.name: the Duck Pond
spots.text: Something glints in the mud of the duck pond. You fish out a Wolf Pelt, and the ducks complain loudly.

towns.name: Murkmarsh
towns.blurb: A quiet town beside an old barrow. By day it sleeps; by night, everyone bars their doors.

mayor.name: Lord Cole
mayor.title: Lord
mayor.avatar: small, brisk lord with a bald head that shines, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a silver circlet
greeting: Come in, come in, before it gets dark! The Queen sent you?
Mordecai sits on a throne of bones in the barrow. Every night, more of the dead march out.

shop.name: The Last Candle

keeper.name: Clover
keeper.avatar: freckled shopkeeper in a patchwork apron, with a cat asleep on the counter

lines: I'm staying till the end. Buy what you need; you'll need it.

workshop.name: The Last Forge

keeper.name: Violet
keeper.avatar: red-haired carpenter with a pencil behind her ear and sawdust in her hair

lines: Everyone else has fled. The anvil's all yours.

npcs.name: Old Winifred
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a knitted shawl, with a basket of eggs
lines: Mordecai? Terrible business. I've seen worse. Not much worse, mind.
Lightbringer, the Emberheart Amulet and the Candle of Dawn. The old songs say you need all three.

npcs.name: Watchman Jory
npcs.avatar: exhausted young watchman in a battered helmet, holding a bucket
lines: Last night a skeleton asked me for directions. I pointed it the wrong way.
I don't sleep. Nobody sleeps. We just wait for the sun.
Only an Emberheart Amulet can turn Mordecai's freezing cold. Tamsin's Trading Post in Heathercombe has one.

spots.name: the Ruined Hall
spots.text: In the rubble of the old hall you find a Greater Healing Draught, somehow unbroken.

towns.name: Icereach
towns.blurb: Terraces of snowy roofs climb the mountainside, joined by steep, icy stairs.

mayor.name: Countess Poppy
mayor.title: Countess
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful countess with a long golden plait, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a silver circlet
greeting: A hero, in Icereach! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Keep your mittens on. Frostbite is no joke.

quest.title: The Hungry Cat
offer: The town cat has stopped catching mice. It wants fish, and it wants it now.
Ned's General Store in Queensgate sells smoked fish, I am told. Bring me one, please.
quest.reminder: Have you found a smoked fish? Ned's General Store in Queensgate sells smoked fish.
done: Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: Ottilie's Trading Post

keeper.name: Ottilie
keeper.avatar: freckled shopkeeper in a patchwork apron, with a cat asleep on the counter

lines: Shut the door! You're letting the winter in.

workshop.name: Basil's Smithy

keeper.name: Basil
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: Keep that fire roaring and you can make anything.

npcs.name: Ranger Ivy
npcs.avatar: hooded ranger with a longbow and a scar across one cheek
lines: The wild wears you down, if you let it.
I can toughen you up, if you've the coin.
The Candle of Dawn can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from two jars of honey for the wax, and some Holy Water. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.

npcs.name: Bram
npcs.avatar: cheerful minstrel in a feathered cap, with a fiddle under one arm
lines: Every hero needs a ballad. Yours is coming along nicely.
Tamsin's Trading Post in Heathercombe sells honey.

npcs.name: Peddler Nell
npcs.avatar: round peddler under a huge pack hung with pots and trinkets
lines: I walk every road in the Oakenreach. Most of them twice.
The Gull & Oyster in Tidecove sells Holy Water.

spots.name: the Snowman
spots.text: Inside the snowman, right where its heart would be: a Greater Healing Draught!

towns.name: Heathercombe
towns.blurb: A shepherds' village of stone walls and windy hilltops.

mayor.name: Duchess Wilhelmina
mayor.title: Duchess
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful duchess with braided red hair, a sea-green robe, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Heathercombe.
On a clear day you can see all the way to Murkmarsh from here.

quest.title: The Golden Egg
offer: Our famous goose laid a golden egg, and somebody has pinched it!
A fox was seen carrying it toward Windknoll. Bring it back and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Golden Egg? A fox was seen carrying it toward Windknoll.
done: The golden egg! And not even cracked!
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: Tamsin's Trading Post

keeper.name: Tamsin
keeper.avatar: wood-elf shopkeeper with leaf-green braids and a quiver on her back

lines: Come in out of the wind!

workshop.name: Cedric's Smithy

keeper.name: Cedric
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: The forge is hot and the anvil is free. Get to it!

npcs.name: Mo
npcs.avatar: beekeeper in a white veiled hat, bees drifting lazily around
lines: My bees make the sweetest honey in the Oakenreach.
Tamsin's Trading Post in Heathercombe sells honey.

npcs.name: Farmer Maud
npcs.avatar: wiry old farmer in a straw hat, with a pitchfork over one shoulder
lines: If you're walking to Murkmarsh, keep an eye out for a grey wolf on the road.
The Golden Egg from Heathercombe is hidden in the Bell Tower in Windknoll.

npcs.name: Miner Silas
npcs.avatar: stocky miner with a lamp on the helmet and coal on the nose
lines: Down in the dark you hear things. Mostly other miners.
The dead cannot bear holy light.

npcs.name: Petra
npcs.avatar: shepherd in a thick wool cloak, with a crook and a sheepdog at heel
lines: The wind up here could blow the whiskers off a cat.
The quickest road to Murkmarsh is the one from Heathercombe.

spots.name: the Sheep Pen
spots.text: A ram is sitting on something, looking very pleased with itself. It is a Rusty Key.

towns.name: Ashwood
towns.blurb: A woodcutters' village in a clearing, where the sawmill hums and the air smells of pine.

mayor.name: Mayor Ellis
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: broad mayor with wild curly hair, a mustard-yellow waistcoat, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: Welcome to Ashwood, Hero! The Queen's messenger said you would come.

quest.title: The Brass Spyglass
offer: The harbour master's spyglass is missing, and nobody can see the ships coming in.
A gull took it. It was last seen flying toward Windknoll. Bring it back and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Brass Spyglass? A gull took it. It was last seen flying toward Windknoll.
done: The spyglass! Now we can watch for ships again.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Acorn & Arrow

keeper.name: Lem
keeper.avatar: red-haired ex-sailor with a tattooed forearm and a gold earring

lines: Everything a traveller needs, and a few things they don't.

workshop.name: Reginald's Woodshop

keeper.name: Reginald
keeper.avatar: bearded woodworker with curls of shavings stuck to his jumper

lines: The grindstone sings when you pedal fast. Make it sing!

npcs.name: Scholar Tobias
npcs.avatar: young scholar with ink-stained fingers and round spectacles
lines: Potions obey those who understand them.
I can teach you, for a modest fee.
The Temple Wind-Chime from Queensgate is hidden in the Woodcutter's Shed in Ashwood.

npcs.name: Agatha
npcs.avatar: beekeeper in a white veiled hat, bees drifting lazily around
lines: Bees know when trouble is coming. Lately they won't leave the hive.
The Brass Spyglass from Ashwood is hidden in the Old Chapel in Windknoll.

spots.name: the Woodcutter's Shed
spots.text: Behind a stack of logs in the old shed you find the Temple Wind-Chime.

towns.name: Windknoll
towns.blurb: A village of cheese-makers, tucked into a fold of the green hills.

mayor.name: Lord Toby
mayor.title: Lord
mayor.avatar: broad lord with a bushy black beard, a sea-green robe, and a silver circlet
greeting: Welcome to Windknoll, Hero! The Queen's messenger said you would come.
Have some cheese. Everyone here has cheese.

quest.title: A Sealed Letter for Queensgate
offer: Would you carry this sealed letter to Count Dunstan in Queensgate? It is about the harvest fair, and it must arrive before the fair does.
Count Dunstan has Lightbringer, and has promised it to whoever brings this.
quest.reminder: Count Dunstan in Queensgate is waiting for the sealed letter.
done: A letter from Windknoll! How lovely. I have been waiting for news.
I have kept Lightbringer safe for years. It is yours now: go and put it to good use.

shop.name: The Woolly Ram

keeper.name: Beatrix
keeper.avatar: freckled shopkeeper in a patchwork apron, with a cat asleep on the counter

lines: Come in out of the wind!

workshop.name: Theobald's Smithy

keeper.name: Theobald
keeper.avatar: wiry tinker with goggles, a tool belt and a grin

lines: Everything I own, I made right here. So can you.

npcs.name: Percival the Magnificent
npcs.avatar: small, round wizard in a patchwork robe covered in singe marks, with spectacles on a chain
lines: Tired of that face? I can change it. A little magic, a little gold.
Build, clothes, hair. Nothing I have not done a thousand times.
The Golden Egg from Heathercombe is hidden in the Bell Tower in Windknoll.

npcs.name: Miner Oswin
npcs.avatar: stocky miner with a lamp on the helmet and coal on the nose
lines: Down in the dark you hear things. Mostly other miners.
The Brass Spyglass from Ashwood is hidden in the Old Chapel in Windknoll.

spots.name: the Bell Tower
spots.text: Up among the bells, in a pigeon's nest: the Golden Egg!

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: the Brass Spyglass.

towns.name: Tidecove
towns.blurb: A snug harbour behind a long stone pier, where the fishing boats come home at dusk.

mayor.name: Countess Kara
mayor.title: Countess
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful countess with a long golden plait, a plum-coloured cloak, and a silver circlet
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Tidecove.
The sea gives and the sea takes. Mostly it gives fish.

quest.title: A Wedding Cake for Icereach
offer: Would you carry this wedding cake to Bram in Icereach? My niece is getting married there, and nobody else can be trusted not to eat it.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Bram in Icereach is waiting for the wedding cake.
done: The cake! And not a single fingerprint in the icing. Wonderful!

shop.name: The Gull & Oyster

keeper.name: Fenella
keeper.avatar: freckled shopkeeper in a patchwork apron, with a cat asleep on the counter

lines: Everything the sea washes up, I sell. Mostly.

workshop.name: Bess's Boatshed

keeper.name: Bess
keeper.avatar: glassblower with goggles pushed up into her curls

lines: Pedal hard and the bellows roar like the sea.

npcs.name: Marigold
npcs.avatar: lighthouse keeper with a lantern and a long grey coat
lines: I keep the light burning every night, storm or no storm.
The Gull & Oyster in Tidecove sells Holy Water.

npcs.name: Godfrey
npcs.avatar: cheerful minstrel in a feathered cap, with a fiddle under one arm
lines: They sing about Mordecai in every tavern now. Not happy songs.
The Old Chest in Tidecove is locked. Its key was lost in the Sheep Pen in Heathercombe years ago.

spots.name: the Old Chest
spots.text: The Rusty Key turns with a screech. Inside the old chest: a Tome of Vigor!
spots.lockedText: A heavy chest sits in the corner, locked tight. The keyhole is caked with rust.

towns.name: Thorndell
towns.blurb: A woodcutters' village in a clearing, where the sawmill hums and the air smells of pine.

mayor.name: Reeve Perry
mayor.title: Reeve
mayor.avatar: white-haired, twinkling-eyed reeve with a neat plait, a sea-green robe, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Thorndell.

quest.title: A Basket of Kittens for Queensgate
offer: Would you carry this basket of kittens to Count Dunstan in Queensgate? Our cat had kittens again, and I hear they have mice.
You'll be well paid for your trouble.
quest.reminder: Count Dunstan in Queensgate is waiting for the basket of kittens.
done: Kittens! Oh, look at them. The mice had better watch out.

shop.name: The Acorn & Arrow

keeper.name: Wystan
keeper.avatar: red-haired ex-sailor with a tattooed forearm and a gold earring

lines: Everything a traveller needs, and a few things they don't.

workshop.name: Rue's Woodshop

keeper.name: Rue
keeper.avatar: cheerful tinker with a tool belt full of odd little tools

lines: Bark, sap and elbow grease. Help yourself to the bench.

npcs.name: Granny Tilly
npcs.avatar: tiny, kindly witch in a mossy shawl, with a toad sitting on her hat
lines: My cat says you have a kind face. My cat is never wrong.
Not all witches are wicked, dearie.

npcs.name: Grandpa Bertram
npcs.avatar: white-bearded grandfather on a bench, with a walking stick across his knees
lines: When I was your age, I fought a bear with a spoon. A big spoon.
Go on, Hero. Show them what Thorndell is made of.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: a Spider Silk.

enemies.name: Thieving Gulls
enemies.taunt: A flock of gulls swoops down, screaming. One of them has your lunch.

enemies.name: Giant Crab
enemies.taunt: A crab the size of a cart clacks its claws.

enemies.name: Pirate Deckhand
enemies.taunt: "Arr! Hand over yer valuables!"

enemies.name: Skeleton
enemies.taunt: A skeleton rattles out of a ditch and raises a rusty sword.

enemies.name: Shambling Zombie
enemies.taunt: A zombie lurches out of the mist, groaning about brains. Or possibly bread.

enemies.name: Marsh Wisp
enemies.taunt: A pale light drifts closer, whispering your name.

enemies.name: Grey Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf slinks out of the grass, teeth bared.

enemies.name: Frost Sprite
enemies.taunt: A shivering sprite hurls a snowball. It is mostly ice.

enemies.name: Frost Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf as white as the snowfield pads closer, its breath freezing in the air.

enemies.name: Road Bandit
enemies.taunt: "Your gold or your life, traveler!"

enemies.name: Wild Ram
enemies.taunt: A ram lowers its curly horns and paws the turf.

enemies.name: White Bear
enemies.taunt: A white bear lumbers out of the snow. It looks hungry, and a bit annoyed.

enemies.name: Wild Boar
enemies.taunt: A boar paws the ground and snorts.

enemies.name: Angry Swan
enemies.taunt: A swan spreads its wings and hisses like a kettle. It wants the whole road to itself.

enemies.name: Goblin Scout
enemies.taunt: A goblin cackles and waves a rusty knife.

enemies.name: Giant Spider
enemies.taunt: A spider as big as a pony drops from the branches on a silver thread.

enemies.name: Brown Bear
enemies.taunt: A bear rears up on its hind legs. It smells of honey and bad temper.

enemies.name: Giant Octopus
enemies.taunt: Eight long arms reach up out of a rock pool. One of them grabs your boot.

enemies.name: Hill Ogre
enemies.taunt: An ogre sits in the road eating a whole cabbage. It wipes its mouth and stands up.

enemies.name: Mordecai the Undying
enemies.taunt: "I have been dead for five hundred years. I am very patient."
enemies.avatar: tall, gaunt lich in faded purple robes, with a staff topped by a glowing skull

Lord Toby of Windknoll is looking for a courier to Queensgate.
Tamsin's Trading Post in Heathercombe sells an Emberheart Amulet. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.
Only an Emberheart Amulet can turn Mordecai's freezing cold. Tamsin's Trading Post in Heathercombe has one.
The Candle of Dawn can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from two jars of honey for the wax, and some Holy Water. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.
Tamsin's Trading Post in Heathercombe sells honey.
The Gull & Oyster in Tidecove sells Holy Water.
The Temple Wind-Chime from Queensgate is hidden in the Woodcutter's Shed in Ashwood.

challenge.title: The Barrows of Murkmarsh
summons: Ah, Hero, you came! Sit, please. I am afraid the news is bad.
Mordecai the Undying has risen from an old barrow near Murkmarsh. Every night the dead climb out of their graves and march on the town.
Our scholars say three things can bring Mordecai down: the sword Lightbringer, an Emberheart Amulet against the chill of the grave, and the Candle of Dawn, which lays the dead to rest.
Find all three, then face Mordecai at the Old Crypt. Ask everyone you meet; the people of the Oakenreach know more than they think.
Here is gold for the road, and a few draughts. My carriage waits to take you to Queensgate. Go with my blessing.

lair.name: the Old Crypt
lair.text: Stone steps lead down into the dark. The air coming up smells of old bones and candle smoke.

victory: You light the Candle of Dawn. Golden light floods the barrow, and the dead lie down, one by one.
Lightbringer blazes like the rising sun. Mordecai crumbles into dust and is gone.
In Murkmarsh the night is quiet at last. In the morning, the chapel bells ring for an hour.
